# Development status

This workflow remains under development. Replace this section only after a
clean render, object inspection, mapping review, expected-count validation, and
approved-location rerender.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(OmicSignature)
```

```{r locate-foundation}
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(current, "codex_reference"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) stop("Could not locate SigRepo repository root.")
    current <- parent
  }
}

REPO_ROOT <- find_repo_root()
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "codex_reference", "helpers", "omicsignature_compat.R"))
sigrepo_assert_compatible_api()
```

```{r paths-and-constants}
SOURCE_FILE <- Sys.getenv("{{SOURCE_ENV_VAR}}", unset = "")
stopifnot(nzchar(SOURCE_FILE), file.exists(SOURCE_FILE))

SIGNATURE_NAME <- "{{SIGNATURE_NAME}}"
APPROVED_PLATFORM <- "{{PLATFORM}}"
APPROVED_SAMPLE_TYPE <- "{{SAMPLE_TYPE}}"
GROUP_LEVELS <- c("{{GROUP_1}}", "{{GROUP_2}}")

# Replace with the exact supported rule and operator.
SIGNATURE_RULE_DESCRIPTION <- "{{EXACT_RULE}}"

sigrepo_assert_platform(APPROVED_PLATFORM)
sigrepo_assert_sample_type(APPROVED_SAMPLE_TYPE)
```

```{r source-and-mapping}
# Read the complete or broader differential-analysis table.
# Map through a reviewed frozen cache under reference_data/.
# Preserve source provenance in development audit tables.

difexp_prepared <- tibble(
  feature_name = character(),
  score = numeric(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  adj_p_value = numeric(),
  group_label = factor(character(), levels = GROUP_LEVELS)
)

stopifnot(nrow(difexp_prepared) > 0L)
stopifnot(identical(levels(difexp_prepared$group_label), GROUP_LEVELS))

# Standardize the parent exactly once. This creates or validates probe IDs.
difexp <- sigrepo_standardize_signature(
  difexp_prepared,
  paste(SIGNATURE_NAME, "parent difexp")
)

# Derive the child from the standardized parent. Do not standardize again.
signature <- difexp %>%
  filter({{EXACT_FILTER_EXPRESSION}})

stopifnot(nrow(signature) > 0L)
```

```{r parent-child-validation}
parent_key <- paste(
  difexp$probe_id,
  difexp$feature_name,
  difexp$score,
  sep = "\r"
)

signature_key <- paste(
  signature$probe_id,
  signature$feature_name,
  signature$score,
  sep = "\r"
)

stopifnot(
  all(signature$probe_id %in% difexp$probe_id),
  all(signature_key %in% parent_key),
  !anyNA(difexp$probe_id),
  !anyDuplicated(difexp$probe_id),
  all(as.character(signature$group_label) %in% GROUP_LEVELS)
)
```

```{r metadata-object}
metadata <- OmicSignature::createMetadata(
  signature_name = SIGNATURE_NAME,
  organism = "{{ORGANISM}}",
  direction_type = "{{DIRECTION_TYPE}}",
  assay_type = "{{ASSAY_TYPE}}",
  phenotype = "{{PHENOTYPE}}",
  platform = APPROVED_PLATFORM,
  sample_type = APPROVED_SAMPLE_TYPE,
  author = "{{AUTHOR}}",
  keywords = sigrepo_keywords(c("{{KEYWORD_1}}", "{{KEYWORD_2}}")),
  cutoff_description = SIGNATURE_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
  description = "{{DESCRIPTION}}"
)

oSig <- OmicSignature::OmicSignature$new(
  metadata = metadata,
  signature = signature,
  difexp = difexp,
  print_message = FALSE
)
```

```{r validation}
stopifnot(
  nrow(oSig$signature) == nrow(signature),
  nrow(oSig$difexp) == nrow(difexp),
  all(oSig$signature$probe_id %in% oSig$difexp$probe_id)
)
```

```{r save-objects, eval=FALSE}
# Enable only after approval and explicit output-path review.
saveRDS(oSig, file.path("{{OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}}", paste0(SIGNATURE_NAME, "_oSig.rds")))
```
